newsitem.title: ESTONIA: UHIS WINS TENDER TO HOLD TALLINN CITY BUDGET.
newsitem.headline: UHIS WINS TENDER TO HOLD TALLINN CITY BUDGET.

text.p: Uhispank was selected on Friday as the bank to hold Tallinn city's budget of approximately 20 million kroons, the city goverment said.
The Tallinn city budget has annual turnover of 2.1 billion kroons and the account usually has around 20 million kroons in it, the city said in a statement.
Previously the budget was held in several different accounts including Uhispank, which made mangement of the accounts difficult, the bank said.
Uhispank Tallinn branch manger Riho Rasmann told Reuters that he was delighted to have won the contract.
"This shows the city was satified with our ability to manage their account, which we held for them over the last four years," he said.
Union bank is looking to manage the funds of other local governments in Estonia as well, he said.
